title: Abjure
summary: ABJU'RE, verb transitive [Latin abjuro, to deny upon oath, from ab and juro, to swear.] 1. To renounce upon oath; to abandon; as to abjure allegiance to a prince. 2. To renounce or reject with solemni

inlines.v: ABJU'RE, verb transitive [Latin abjuro, to deny upon oath, from ab and juro, to swear.] 1. To renounce upon oath; to abandon; as to abjure allegiance to a prince. 2. To renounce or reject with solemnity; to reject; as to abjure errors; abjure reason. 3. To recant or retract. 4. To banish. [Not used.]
